fields.name: campaign_name
fields.desc: 营销活动名（按 campaign 关键字映射）
fields.logic: case when lower(campaign) like '%cpf07%' then 'cpf07' when lower(campaign) like '%cpf10%' then 'cpf10' when lower(campaign) like '%cpf06%' then 'cpf06' when lower(campaign) like '%cpx05%' then 'X05' when lower(campaign) like '%cpx07%' or lower(campaign) like '%cpx%' then 'X07' when lower(campaign) like '%cpv%2%' and lower(campaign) like '%bin1to8%' then 'cpv2_bin1to8' when lower(campaign) like '%cpv%2%' and lower(campaign) like '%weighted%' then 'cpv2_weighted' when lower(campaign) like '%cpv%' then 'cpv' else '其他' end
fields.desc_orig: 营销活动名（按 campaign 关键字映射）
